title: Derive the role table from declared inheritance
task:
`ROLE_PERMISSIONS` repeats every inherited permission by hand, so adding one permission means editing several rows and the table drifts.

Rewrite `src/permissions.mjs` so each role declares only the permissions it adds plus the role it extends (`viewer` → `editor` → `approver` → `admin`), and derive the full table from that declaration. `ROLE_PERMISSIONS` must stay exported and must still expose the same frozen, fully expanded permission lists it does today.

Deny-by-default is unchanged: an unknown role grants nothing, and a cycle in the inheritance declaration must throw at module load rather than silently granting a partial set.

Behaviour-preserving: `test/permissions.test.mjs` passes untouched.
